title: Forget AI coding agents. Give me an AI marketing department.
author: ZymzAlchemy
selftext:
I can write code.

I can make the art.

I need an AI that wakes up every morning and goes:

**"I clipped your gameplay, made the Short, posted it everywhere, answered three comments, contacted six creators, and somehow got you mentioned by IGN. Go make the damn game."**

*That's* the agentic future I'm waiting for.

replies.author: Officialpolygrafix
replies.body:
The way to beat this, isn't purely automation. It's creating a community and then cross promoting and surfacing games to similar demographics that are interested in those type of games.

What do i mean?   
I used to work for a mobile game company, and the owner had a brilliant strategy for growth, made tens of millions in a few short years, then he sold the company and exited game development. 

Here is what he did.   
He made kids games. Low standard for gameplay and art, quick turnaround for development. A game could be made in a month.  the games were easy to play, quick and not much too them, but kids liked them. He would rank up in the app store based on download velocity. If 10000 people downloaded his game in a few hours, then it would push him to the top of the charts for the category he listed it in, which game him even more growth, and more velocity, allowing his games to dominate the charts in early 2010's.  
How did he get 10k downloads so fast?   
he setup a notification system on all his games. Whenever he launched a new game, he would send out notifications to his entire install base, and thus 10's of thousands of downloads came in quickly.  he repeated this and built out as many games as he could in that time, and have well over a 100 games by the time he sold the company. 

The takeway:  He networked his new games across his existing install base.  Since these were all kids games, he was targeting the same demographic, so the interest was already there. 

Now imagine if a group of devs did the same thing? Not one person, but an entire group of devs, Helping to expose other devs games, to other players with the same interests- after they had already purchased that game? Some type of cross promotional platform that intelligently surfaces games those players may like. 

Now throw in some AI tiktok,  youtube and instagram Gamer influencers promoting games within this, and you have a solid foundation to build from.

comments.author: Duet_Yourself
comments.body:
I’m actually working on this and getting closer.

https://www.marketstand.org

Using it for my site https://www.sensipets.com

I have it so only I can login. But have it connected to the repo, analytics platform, marketing APIs, and more. Biggest issue I’m encountering is creating systems to best understand approved audiences, which ad platforms to focus on, and how to evaluate the outcome of run campaigns.

Right now it:  
\- scrapes your site for content, brand, assets  
\- finds competitors in the space  
\- identifies features that are differentiators  
\- suggests for approval audiences/copy/landing pages  
\- proposes campaigns for meta, Reddit, google
